zero_relative_clause.label: relative clause with that/who/which omitted (the man I saw)

that_relative_clause.label: relative clause headed by that (the man that I saw)

sentential_relative.label: non-restrictive which-clause with a clausal antecedent (…, which …)

reduced_relative_clause.label: participial relative with no complementizer (the man sitting…)

noun_appositive_that.label: content-noun + that-clause with no gap (the fact that he left)

zero_that_complement.label: verb taking a finite clause with that omitted (I think he left)

ditransitive.label: verb with two object NPs (WordNet frame 14)

be_passive.label: be + past participle of a WordNet-transitive verb

get_passive.label: get + past participle of a WordNet-transitive verb

imperative.label: subjectless base-form verb (Leave. / Don't wait. / Please sit.)

pseudo_cleft.label: wh-clause + be + XP (What he wants is a raise)

reverse_pseudo_cleft.label: XP + be + wh-clause (A raise is what he wants)

purpose_infinitive.label: to-infinitive adjunct of purpose (left to catch… / in order to)

free_relative.label: fused wh-clause used as an NP (what he said / whoever comes)

comparative_than.label: comparative + than (bigger than / more interesting than)

when_adjunct.label: when-clause adjunct (not a relative, not a complement)

nominal_apposition.label: two NPs, second a description of the first (my friend the lawyer)

negative_inversion.label: fronted negative + aux + subject (Never have I…)

locative_inversion.label: fronted PP + motion verb + subject (Down the hill came…)

object_fronting.label: fronted object + subject + finite (This I cannot accept)

fragment.label: sentence with no verb (Pieces, state, invariants.)

colon_label.label: opens with a short label and a colon (Cost: …)

ends_colon.label: ends with a colon (a list lead-in)

hedge.label: hedge or casual intensifier (pretty, basically, just, I think, really)

not_x_but_y.label: antithesis (not X but Y / isn't X, it's Y)

list_of_three.label: list of three (X, Y and Z)

imperative_start.label: starts with a bare verb (Skim it…)

claude.label: fused wh-clause used as an NP (what he said / whoever comes)
list of three (X, Y and Z)

codex.label: list of three (X, Y and Z)

grok.label: list of three (X, Y and Z)
